verses.text: Hórruit spíritus meus: ego Dániel térritus sum in his, et visiónes cápitis mei conturbavérunt me.

Hæ quátuor béstiæ magnæ, quátuor sunt regna, quæ consúrgent de terra.

verses.text: Suscípient autem regnum sancti Dei altíssimi, et obtinébunt regnum usque in sǽculum, et sǽculum sæculórum.

Post hoc vólui diligénter díscere de béstia quarta, quæ erat dissímilis valde ab ómnibus, et terríbilis nimis: dentes et ungues ejus férrei: comedébat, et comminuébat, et réliqua pédibus suis conculcábat:
Et de córnibus decem, quæ habébat in cápite.

responsory.text: Sustinúimus pacem, et non venit: quæsívimus bona, et ecce turbátio: cognóvimus, Dómine, peccáta nostra;
Peccávimus, ímpie géssimus, iniquitátem fécimus, Dómine, in omnem justítiam tuam.
Non in perpétuum obliviscáris nos.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

Et de córnibus decem, quæ habébat in cápite.

responsory.text: We looked for peace, and it came not we asked for good, and behold trouble. We acknowledge, O Lord, our wickedness.
O Lord (our God) we have sinned, we have done ungodly, we have dealt unrighteously in all thine ordinances.
Forget us not for ever.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

Matins · Tuesday, 10 November 2026

Tuesday of the Fifth Week after Epiphany

Feria III infra Hebdomadam V post Epiphaniam · Feria

Read in Latin and English

Lesson I

De Daniéle Prophéta

Dan 7:13-14

Aspiciébam ergo in visióne noctis, et ecce cum núbibus cæli quasi fílius hóminis veniébat, et usque ad antíquum diérum pervénit: et in conspéctu ejus obtulérunt eum. Et dedit ei potestátem, et honórem, et regnum: et omnes pópuli, tribus, et linguæ ipsi sérvient: potéstas ejus, potéstas ætérna, quæ non auferétur: et regnum ejus, quod non corrumpétur.

℟. I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem;which shall never hold their peace day nor night, to praise the name of the Lord.

℣. They shall proclaim My might unto the nations, and declare My glory unto the Gentiles.

℟. Which shall never hold their peace day nor night, to praise the name of the Lord.

Lesson II

Dan 7:15-17

Hórruit spíritus meus: ego Dániel térritus sum in his, et visiónes cápitis mei conturbavérunt me. Accéssi ad unum de assisténtibus, et veritátem quærébam ab eo de ómnibus his. Qui dixit mihi interpretatiónem sermónum, et dócuit me: Hæ quátuor béstiæ magnæ, quátuor sunt regna, quæ consúrgent de terra.

℟. Hedge us about with thy wall that cannot be broken down, O Lord, and shield us continually with the arms of thy might. * O Lord God of Israel, deliver them that cry unto thee.

℣. Deliver us also according to thy marvellous works, and give glory to thy Name.

℟. O Lord God of Israel, deliver them that cry unto thee.

Lesson III

Dan 7:18-20

Suscípient autem regnum sancti Dei altíssimi, et obtinébunt regnum usque in sǽculum, et sǽculum sæculórum. Post hoc vólui diligénter díscere de béstia quarta, quæ erat dissímilis valde ab ómnibus, et terríbilis nimis: dentes et ungues ejus férrei: comedébat, et comminuébat, et réliqua pédibus suis conculcábat: Et de córnibus decem, quæ habébat in cápite.

℟. We looked for peace, and it came not we asked for good, and behold trouble. We acknowledge, O Lord, our wickedness. * Forget us not for ever.

℣. O Lord (our God) we have sinned, we have done ungodly, we have dealt unrighteously in all thine ordinances.

℟. Forget us not for ever.

℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

℟. Forget us not for ever.

Read in Latin and English
